name: smwgraphics-vanilla-cutscene
title: Vanilla cutscene
description:
For those who always wanted to make a vanilla cutscene without Romi's Cutscene Tool, here is your present.
Features uppercase letters, lowercase ones, punctuation, numbers from 0 to 9, and an "up" arrow.

This took me more than 10 hours to "make", transfer and reorganize, so could you give credit please ?
